title: Tiger cub holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d="M62 38 Q58 48 55 56" stroke="#e8e8e8" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx="66" cy="26" rx="12" ry="14" fill="#ff5555"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="22" rx="4" ry="5" fill="#ff9999" opacity="0.7"/>
  <polygon points="66,40 63,44 69,44" fill="#cc3333"/>
  <!-- tiger body -->
  <ellipse cx="42" cy="72" rx="20" ry="16" fill="#ffb732"/>
  <!-- body stripes -->
  <path d="M30 62 Q32 68 30 74" stroke="#5a3a1a" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M50 60 Q52 66 50 72" stroke="#5a3a1a" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M27 75 Q31 78 29 84" stroke="#5a3a1a" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M52 74 Q54 78 51 84" stroke="#5a3a1a" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d="M22 78 Q12 72 10 62 Q9 58 13 58" stroke="#ffb732" stroke-width="4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M13 58 Q10 56 12 54" stroke="#5a3a1a" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <ellipse cx="32" cy="86" rx="7" ry="5" fill="#ffb732"/>
  <ellipse cx="52" cy="86" rx="7" ry="5" fill="#ffb732"/>
  <ellipse cx="32" cy="88" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#ffd98a"/>
  <ellipse cx="52" cy="88" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#ffd98a"/>
  <!-- raised arm holding string -->
  <path d="M55 64 Q60 58 63 54" stroke="#ffb732" stroke-width="5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="63" cy="53" r="3.5" fill="#ffd98a"/>
  <!-- other arm -->
  <path d="M28 68 Q24 72 22 76" stroke="#ffb732" stroke-width="5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="22" cy="77" r="3.5" fill="#ffd98a"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="44" r="18" fill="#ffb732"/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx="28" cy="29" r="6" fill="#ffb732"/>
  <circle cx="56" cy="29" r="6" fill="#ffb732"/>
  <circle cx="28" cy="29" r="3.5" fill="#ff9999"/>
  <circle cx="56" cy="29" r="3.5" fill="#ff9999"/>
  <!-- forehead stripes -->
  <path d="M38 30 Q38 34 36 36" stroke="#5a3a1a" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M42 28 Q42 33 42 35" stroke="#5a3a1a" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M46 30 Q46 34 48 36" stroke="#5a3a1a" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- cheek stripes -->
  <path d="M26 42 Q29 43 28 46" stroke="#5a3a1a" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M58 42 Q55 43 56 46" stroke="#5a3a1a" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx="42" cy="52" rx="10" ry="7" fill="#ffeebb"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx="35" cy="42" rx="3.5" ry="4" fill="#2a1a0a"/>
  <ellipse cx="49" cy="42" rx="3.5" ry="4" fill="#2a1a0a"/>
  <circle cx="36" cy="40.5" r="1.3" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="40.5" r="1.3" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx="42" cy="49" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#e07070"/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d="M39 52 Q42 55 45 52" stroke="#8a5a2a" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <path d="M30 50 L24 49" stroke="#fff5e0" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M30 53 L24 55" stroke="#fff5e0" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M54 50 L60 49" stroke="#fff5e0" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M54 53 L60 55" stroke="#fff5e0" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
